fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects a suspicious Microsoft desktopimgdownldr execution with parameters used to download files from the Internet
fields.name: Suspicious Desktopimgdownldr Command
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains " /lockscreenurl:" and (not (tgt.process.cmdline contains ".jpg" or tgt.process.cmdline contains ".jpeg" or tgt.process.cmdline contains ".png"))) or (tgt.process.cmdline contains "reg delete" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\PersonalizationCSP")))
